name: Minowa Totomaru
source:
"There's no way I can remain quiet after you looked down on me."

[Class] First Year Sumiregumi (Violet)
[Personality] Genuine, Compassionate
[Specialty] Karate

Just after he entered high school, he talked big about crushing the class but then had his ass kicked by the [url=/c39873]heroine[/url]. After that, he recognized her superiority and became her close friend. As a person who isn't two faced and is a good-natured person to interact with, he treasures bonds between people, and will help others without compensation. Even though he's together with the heroine more often than anyone else, he's a thickheaded person who hasn't noticed at all that she's a girl.

[Translation taken from [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/11/14/kenka-banchou-otome/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
